[RDSC.17.2] `module_id` names the module whose block holds the item
([RDSC.4.7]), and `source_order` the item's place in that block, counted over
its fact and cache items together. A runtime must apply the items in ascending
`module_id`, then ascending `source_order`: that is [LGRA.24.3]'s order, because
`module_id` ascends in import-DAG order ([RDSC.8.1.1]). A fact item's slot values
and a cache item's value are `TestSlotLiteral`s, as a `.dstest`'s `TestFact`
carries them; a cache item's `slot_name` is unused.
